==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. A woman made of stars offers to make a reality for me. (The Star Woman wore thick pale white foundation, crimson eyeliner, and had glowing yellow eyes. Her hair was styled like a curly black afro with crimson red highlights, and she wore a silky red robe made of starlight. She had an hourglass figure, and her skin was black as the night sky and covered in twinkling white stars.)
I refuse her offer, and she insists that we were made for each other.
She traps me in a reality bubble, but I eventually escape and put her in a Lucid Light dome. (The reality bubble resembled a cosmic cocoon, like an egg made of galaxies.)
